about.title: About
about.text:
I'm **Ndiaga Ndiaye**, a **full-stack web developer and digital entrepreneur based in Dakar, Senegal**. I build websites, SaaS products and business applications that solve practical problems for organisations and their teams.

I work with **Laravel (PHP), JavaScript, React and Next.js**, from user interfaces and APIs to databases, deployments and maintenance. I care as much about understanding a business need as I do about the quality of the code.

I founded **[KAMIT Digital Solutions](https://kamit.tech)** to help businesses develop reliable, useful digital tools. I also build independent projects, including **[KUMBA](https://kumba.media)**, where I explore AI and digital publishing.

Explore [my projects](/projects), read my [build journal](/blog), or [get in touch](/contact) to discuss a web application or digital project.
